cases.classic_sql: SELECT author.author, books.name, books.pages, books.year FROM books, author WHERE author.author LIKE '%aro%' AND books.author=author.id LIMIT 1000
cases.core_sql:
SELECT  a3002.val as 'author',a3003_val as 'book',a3007_val as 'pages',a3009_val as 'year'
FROM bk a3002
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT r3003.t,a3003.val a3003_val,a3007.val a3007_val,a3009.val a3009_val
  FROM bk r3003,bk a3003 /*USE INDEX (PRIMARY)*/
   LEFT JOIN bk a3007 ON a3007.up=a3003.id AND a3007.t=3007
   LEFT JOIN bk a3009 ON a3009.up=a3003.id AND a3009.t=3009
    WHERE r3003.up=a3003.id AND r3003.val='3005'  AND a3003.t=3003
   ) a3003 ON a3002.id=a3003.t 
WHERE a3002.up!=0 AND a3002.t!=a3002.up AND length(a3002.val)!=0 AND a3002.t=3002  AND a3002.val  LIKE '%aro%'       LIMIT 0,1000
